title: GLG Faces Class Action Lawsuit Over Data Breach Affecting 152,000 Individuals
summary: GLG disclosed a November 2023 ransomware attack that compromised names and Social Security numbers of 152,621 individuals. A class action lawsuit alleges negligent failure to protect personal data and inadequate response measures. GLG offered 12 months of credit monitoring.
whyItMatters: A major data breach at the industry's largest player raises questions about cybersecurity practices across all expert networks handling sensitive expert data.
